body:
It's still a bug in safari when you have date like that: 2017-11-02 00:00:00.000

edit: `'2017-11-02 00:00:00.000'.replace(/\s/g, "T")` this work's in Safari and Chrome.
Sadly this is still there for spaces. Easier if you are working with mongodb where date is stored in ISO 8601 format.

@michaell94 well, event if i have `2017-11-02 00:00:00` date i get an error:

```
ERROR: ERROR Error: InvalidPipeArgument: '2018-02-28 00:00:00' for pipe 't'
```

Yes, use following format - 2017-11-02T00:00:00Z

NOTE Z at the end, else you will have timezone issue in Safari and Chrome. :)
